name: Load Off!
source:
A down on his luck college dropout, receives a mysterious letter with a vague offer. You've been invited to participate on a game show where you put your dignity on the line. Is this an opportunity of a lifetime or a deal with the devil? On the surface it's just a run-of-the-mill quiz game show, but it's unusually kinky and perverted. Is there something sinister at play here? Can you beat the competition and come out on top? Or will you succumb to the show and lose more than just your dignity? See what's revealed as you take a chance and play, Load Off!

[From [url=https://www.furaffinity.net/view/18326038/]FurAffinity[/url]]
